fichas.title: Daylight: Radiation Energy
fichas.summary: Explains how latitude, weather, and sky conditions affect daylight and solar radiation. Covers global radiation, atmospheric scattering and absorption, the spectral distribution of solar energy, and the implications for daylight and passive and active heat use in architecture. Figures show seasonal radiation in Germany, solar radiation and sunshine in the UK, weather-dependent radiation and daylight conditions, and solar radiation intensity by wavelength.
uses: Assess local daylight and solar heat conditions
Inform daylight design and passive and active use of solar heat
